drawing.inkNote: Full ink is priced from Kulka's completed jobs. Light ink is priced from Kulka's stated rates.

criteria.label: Construction Type
criteria.method: IBC 2021 and 2025 BCNYS R-2 limits by stories, framing and podium.
prices: Wood Framing - Install + Wood Framing - Supply
criteria.confidenceReason: Wood framing with no podium, clear of the type's height and area limits.

criteria.label: Building Form
criteria.method: Double-loaded corridor wings 64 ft deep; past 300 ft of corridor the plate folds into an L, past 480 ft a U, past 720 ft a courtyard.
prices: Wood Framing - Install + Wood Framing - Supply
criteria.confidenceReason: There is no site plan yet, so the shape follows from the floor plate's length alone.

criteria.label: Electrical Service Size
criteria.method: NEC 220.84 optional multifamily calculation, one service per building.
criteria.confidenceReason: Amenity space and equipment are not measured, so the common area is priced at the clubs rate and pool or sauna equipment is left out. Elevator motors carry a 40 HP placeholder until the elevator vendor's data replaces it.

inputs.name: Appliances per Unit
inputs.value: Range, dryer, water heater, 6 kW heat (NEC Annex D4(b))

criteria.label: Window Area and Orientation
criteria.method: Glazing band from balconies and storefronts, mapped to DOE's apartment prototypes.
criteria.confidenceReason: No code or intake fact measures window area directly; balconies and storefronts point different ways, so the standard band is used.

criteria.label: HVAC Tonnage
criteria.method: Gross square feet over DOE's IECC 2021 apartment prototype GSF per ton, by climate zone and glazing band.
criteria.confidenceReason: New construction in a stated climate zone, with no garage in the area and ventilation within the prototype; the ratio is DOE's code-minimum prototype, not a load calculation for this building.

steps.label: Ventilation Check
steps.result: 53 cfm per 1,000 SF, within the prototype's 58

criteria.label: Foundation System
criteria.method: Bearing pressure over IBC Class 4's presumptive value, then ground and basement.
prices: Support of Excavation + Underpinning and Lagging + Existing Building Shoring Design
criteria.confidenceReason: There is no geotechnical report yet. Ground conditions are not known, so ground improvement or deep foundations may still be needed. Rock is possible in this area, so footings and trenches may need rock excavation.

steps.label: Ground
steps.result: Not known, priced as good ground

criteria.label: Elevator Type
criteria.method: Travel from Stories Above Grade against the hydraulic-to-traction band.
criteria.confidenceReason: Travel of 40.0 ft sits inside the either band (over 35 ft, up to 55 ft), where hydraulic and traction are both common. Nothing is set up to choose between the two, so V-1 proposes Hydraulic, the cheaper type.

steps.label: Band
steps.result: Either; nothing set up to choose, so Hydraulic

criteria.label: Hydraulic Jack Type
criteria.method: Travel against each jack's reach in the manufacturers' planning guides.
criteria.confidenceReason: Travel of 40.0 ft works either way, and nobody has said whether the ground is wet, so V-2 prices the well hole to be safe. This ZIP can hit shallow rock, and the intake does not ask about rock, so confidence is low.

steps.label: Band
steps.result: Over 34 ft, up to 48 ft -> In-Ground

criteria.label: Elevator Machine Rooms
criteria.method: Machine rooms by elevator type, count and building.
criteria.confidenceReason: Hydraulic cars share one machine room per bank at the lowest landing (Otis, Schindler), conditioned to the maker's range (IBC 3005.2). With 2 cars in a building, separate cores would double the rooms. V-1 could still flip to traction, which has no machine room.

steps.label: Machine Rooms
steps.result: 1 (one per building, cars in one bank)

notes.text: The project is multifamily new construction.
Gross floor area is 64,000 square feet.
Every line is a range rather than a point, and no line here is a bid.
Blend weights, flag thresholds, and range widths are recorded pricing parameters, each with its own provenance, listed with this budget.

11 items are in scope with no rate yet: Cab Interior Finish Package, Elevator Pit Ladder, Pit Light and GFCI Receptacle, Emergency Two-Way Communication Line, Machine Room HVAC, Hoistway Door Frame Grouting, Hydraulic Well Hole and Casing, Plumbing Disconnect and Cap, Gas Meter and Service Disconnect, Electrical Service Disconnect, Site Utility Cut and Cap at the Main.
33 of 43 lines are low confidence and are held for review before this budget is relied on.
3 of 43 lines rest on estimator judgment with no measured Kulka figure behind them yet.
Answered no, so this budget carries nothing for: a tie-in to an existing building.
Not in this job, so removed from the total: Overhead Doors (parking type), Storefronts (retail storefronts), Building Concrete (parking type), BDA System (radio amplifier).

1 item sits outside this total as TBD, because nobody knows the answer yet: Support of Excavation + Underpinning and Lagging + Existing Building Shoring Design (levels below grade and site conditions).
39 of 43 lines have no stated level of detail yet, so they are shown without one rather than at a guessed level.
1 of 43 lines are owner-direct scope, included in total project cost and excluded from Kulka's contract total.

Structure Demolition brings in Plumbing Disconnect and Cap, Gas Meter and Service Disconnect, Electrical Service Disconnect, Site Utility Cut and Cap at the Main. Each adds to the total on its own once it has a rate.

Elevators brings in Cab Interior Finish Package, Elevator Pit Ladder, Pit Light and GFCI Receptacle, Emergency Two-Way Communication Line, Machine Room HVAC, Hoistway Door Frame Grouting, Hydraulic Well Hole and Casing. Each adds to the total on its own once it has a rate.

Fee computes on the subtotal plus the General Requirements and General Conditions line, and insurance on the subtotal, General Requirements and General Conditions, and fee, in that order. Markups apply to Kulka's contract only; owner-direct scope carries none.

markupWords: Markups priced as a percent of the subtotal, General Requirements and General Conditions as one line.

paragraphs.text: 35 of the 38 priced lines stand on two buildings Kulka has completed, Fieldstone North Broadway and Jefferson's Ferry NW ILU Building 1.
The other 3 rest on rates Kulka has stated.
No line here is a bid.

Where a decision has not been made, we have assumed one and marked it. 9 design criteria set the construction type (Type IIIA), the foundation (spread footings), the electrical service (1,600 A), the elevators (2 hydraulic cars, 1 machine room) and the cooling load (91 tons). Each is called out on the section drawing inside, and each is yours to change.
One question is still open: “Are there known groundwater or poor soil conditions?” Until it is answered, what waits on it sits outside the total rather than inside it as a guess.

Read the facts on the next page. If one is wrong, tell us and we reprice from the corrected fact. Then comes Design Development. Kulka's estimators price the design development drawings, and the range narrows.
